title: sTimeSteal
description: sTimeSteal is a hardcore survival plugin where time acts as health and currency. Steal minutes via PvP, trade with others, or face elimination. Features a full economy with withdrawable vouchers and revival.
body: # ⏳ sTimeSteal - The Borrowed Breath System ### **Hardcore SMP | Time Economy | PvP Mechanics** **sTimeSteal** turns time into your most vital resource. In this hardcore gamemode, your remaining playtime is your life. Every second you play ticks down your clock. If it hits `00:00:00`, you are eliminated and enter **Ghost Mode**. Survival depends on aggression and economy. Kill others to steal their time, trade minutes with friends using vouchers, store your time in the bank, or wield powerful time-infused items. --- ## ✨ Features ### **1. ⏳ The Life Timer** Every second in-game is a second lost. Your time is always visible above your hotbar. * **Green**: Safe (> 6 Hours) * **Gold**: Caution (≤ 6 Hours) * **Red**: Critical (≤ 1 Hour) ### **2. 💀 PvP Time Stealing & Bounties** Killing a player isn't just for loot—it's for life. * **Kill Bonus**: Steal **1 Hour** (Configurable) from your victim. * **Death Penalty**: Dying to mobs or suicide costs you **10 Minutes**. * **Bounties**: Place time bounties on enemies! The killer collects the bounty reward automatically. * **Grace Period**: New players receive a configurable grace period, protecting them from PvP time theft. ### **3. 👻 Ghost Mode** When your time reaches zero, you don't get banned. You become a **Ghost**! * Ghosts are invisible, put in Adventure mode, and cannot interact with the physical world (no breaking/placing blocks, picking up items, or dealing/taking damage). * You must haunt your friends until they resurrect you! ### **4. 💎 Economy & Trading** Time is money. Literally. * ` /paytime `: Send minutes directly to other players. * ` /withdraw `: Convert your time into physical **Time Vouchers** (Paper items) to trade. * ` /timebank `: Store your time safely away from death penalties, but beware of the deposit fee! * ` /timetop `: See who the wealthiest players are on the server. ### **5. 🕯️ Revive Beacons & Abilities** Spend your time or gather resources for powerful rituals. * **Revive Beacons**: Craft a normal or a **Greater Revive Beacon** (which grants more starting time). Place it and sacrifice a player's head inside the GUI to resurrect them! * **Time-Infused Items**: Craft items like the **Time Sword** (costs time to deal bonus damage) or the **Time Shield** (costs 30 minutes to reverse a fatal blow). --- ## 📜 Commands & Permissions | Command | Permission | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/withdraw ` | `None` | Convert your time into a physical Voucher item. | | `/paytime ` | `None` | Send time directly to another player. | | `/bounty ` | `None` | View or place bounties on players. | | `/timebank ` | `None` | Manage your banked time safely. | | `/timetop` | `None` | Display the top 10 richest players. | | `/stimesteal givevoucher ...` | `stimesteal.admin` | (Admin) Give a voucher to a player without cost. | --- ## ⚙️ Configuration The plugin is highly configurable! Edit `config.yml` to change values. ```yaml # Time given to new players (Default: 6 hours) starting-time: 360 # Time set when a player is revived (Default: 6 hours) revive-time: 360 # Time set when revived with a Greater Revive Beacon greater-revive-time: 720 # Grace period for new players (Default: 24 hours) grace-period-time: 1440 # Time stolen on PvP kill (Default: 1 hour) kill-steal-time: 60 # Time Bank settings time-bank: deposit-fee-percent: 5.0 ``` --- ## 🛠️ Installation 1. Download the `.jar` file. 2. Place it in your server's `plugins` folder. 3. Restart your server. 4. The clock starts ticking immediately! --- **Developed by SiteSizer**
